notes.title: Été v.1.0.2
notes.content:
Été v.1.0.2 is a minor patch consisting mostly of bugfixes.

However, one often request quality of life change made it in: while at the easel (painting on canvas), time will [u][b]pause at dusk[/b][/u], meaning you will no longer get kicked out of painting to sleep! You can spend as much uninterrupted time as you want painting an artwork. Do note however that earlier in the day, time will progress normally, all the way to the end (dusk).

Full change log:
[list]
[*] Changed: Disable time passing at dusk while at easel
[*] Changed: Increase first burst charge requirement during tutorial
[*] Fixed: Missing ruined brick walls from album
[*] Fixed: Impossible to store decorations
[*] Fixed: Floating avatar spike in safari tent moment
[*] Fixed: Oversized bus stop in apt diorama
[*] Fixed: Dyslexia-alleviating font broken in some interface elements
[*] Fixed: Unreachable drops above some lampposts
[*] Fixed: Unreachable drops on tarp of Fabienne's workshop
[*] Fixed: Utility poles not fully filling visually
[*] Fixed: Decoration duplication bug when using the debug panel
[*] Fixed: Possible to get stuck in furniture pile during moving day argument in Alleyway
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who reported bugs! Keep them coming!

notes.title: Été v.1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]New[/h1]
[h3]Artwork Mailing[/h3]
[list]
[*]Mailing artworks no longer removes them from the game
[*]Any artwork can now be mailed, even those turned in for quests or sold
[*]Previously mailed artworks will be returned to the portfolio upon updating
[*]Remove artwork mailing restriction during special quest moments (e.g. tutorial sparrow, graffiti tag)
[*]Lowered exported artwork resolution from 4K to 2K so the filesize is below limits of Discord & most social media
[/list]
[h3]Time Passing[/h3]
[list]
[*]Time no longer progresses while in the Album
[*]Time no longer progresses while in the Map
[/list]
[h3]Exposition[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added party decorations during expo (technically should always have been there but got disabled by mistake in the v.1.0.0 build -- oops!)
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Decoration doesn't deselect on opening inventory, which can softlock tutorial when picking another decoration with one currently selected
[*]Fixed: Special quest-only exhibits can be manipulated by players, leading to narrative bugs, softlocks, and seemingly disappearing artworks
[*]Fixed: Edge case where same artwork could be delivered for both I <3 MTL and Graffiti School, softlocking the graffiti quest chain
[*]Fixed: Softlock when Inventory screen was restored from the GUI stack, e.g. after canceling the sleep prompt
[*]Fixed: Album-excluded subjects counting as commission requirement fulfillers
[*]Fixed: Physics bugs when storing a decoration that is on top of the avatar
[*]Fixed: Physics bugs when a machine (door, container, etc.) finished moving while on top of the avatar
[*]Fixed: Possible to climb past invisible wall during apartment decoration tutorial
[*]Fixed: Bursts cannot be placed close enough for full coverage
[*]Fixed: Normal paint cannot be placed close enough for full coverage (although temporary)
[*]Fixed: Money shown in Inventory screen not updating in some cases, showing old number
[*]Fixed: Missing graffiti tag from Railroad diorama
[*]Fixed: Slot erase prompt case sensititivy is too strict
[*]Fixed: Decoration: Decoration-specific notifications/tutorials showing in unusable decoration zones (e.g. unrepaired Studio wings)
[*]Fixed: Texture scale on Pepper
[*]Fixed: Player getting option saying they already tried speaking to Peggy at the café before she purchased a triptych when they haven't
[*]Fixed: Artworks purchased by Peggy or Marianne not appearing where they should seemingly randomly
[*]Fixed: Audio volume levels on some songs and sounds
[*]Fixed: Machines in inventory previews attempting to save state to save file
[*]Fixed: Album: Hot dog wiener is unpickable stamp in album
[*]Fixed: Album: Porthole Door Frame is unpickable in the album
[*]Fixed: Album: Kim and Roxanne stamps showing as only eyes/teeth in the album
[*]Fixed: Album: Conspiracy Board stamp showing only as red strings in the album
[*]Fixed: Decoration: Decorations having invalid bounds for occupancy checks when rotated
[*]Fixed: Decoration: Missing Info Board decoration name
[*]Fixed: Decoration: Flying towel rack in apartment pre-existing decorations
[*]Fixed: Decoration: Missing artwork texture on hung flag decoration item
[*]Fixed: Market: Can walk through open garage red doors before buying bike (could not reproduce, but added safety invisible wall)
[*]Fixed: Market: Dumpster flap behind Fabienne's garage clips into wall when opened
[*]Fixed: Market: Unreachable droplets behind the fence towards the Park
[*]Fixed: Market: Falafel stand shop displays appear before finishing Key to the City
[*]Fixed: Market: Possible to sit on the chair inside the egg stand in Market and get stuck there
[*]Fixed: Market: Art inquiry sign in café appearing before second day
[*]Fixed: Alleyway: Safety net respawns player when they go under dog yard fence
[*]Fixed: Alleyway: String error in note behind tea salon terrace in French
[*]Fixed: Alleyway: NPC in zen yard in Alleyway is clipping through his seat
[*]Fixed: Alleyway: Windows from the bodyweight enthusiast's building disappear in Alleyway when on the balcony with Quebec flags
[*]Fixed: Neighborhood: Unreachable drops in green alleyway
[*]Fixed: Neighborhood: Various unfillable bushes 
[*]Fixed: Neighborhood: Add invisible walls to prevent falling in colonial house yard
[*]Fixed: Neighborhood: Collision geometry failure near dépanneur fridge
[*]Fixed: Neighborhood: Duplicate Roger in behind dépanneur counter under specific circumstances
[*]Fixed: Railroad: Various duplicated NPCs under certain specific circumstances
[*]Fixed: Railroad: Double rotation on makeshift wind turbines and their propellors
[*]Fixed: Railroad: Chilling guy clipping through chair
[*]Fixed: Railroad: Two NPCs clipping through pallet pile
[*]Fixed: Railroad: Unreachable drops from hangar and locomotive
[*]Fixed: Railroad: Zac standing on his chair during his reminder background idle
[*]Fixed: Railroad: Misaligned characters during board game moments
[*]Fixed: Formatting error in kid astronauts quest dialogue in French
[*]Fixed: Park: Moved tamtam listeners to correct location
[*]Fixed: Park: NPC standing through bench
[*]Fixed: Park: NPC sitting next to bench
[*]Fixed: Park: NPC child clipping through playground module
[*]Fixed: Park: Unreachable drops from far-reaching lilypads on pond
[*]Fixed: Park: Placement of NPCs sitting on large rock
[*]Fixed: Park: Misplaced graffiti exhibits
[*]Fixed: Graffiti exhibits showing as canvases throughout the city
[/list]
